hits.title: Cracker Barrel
hits.snippet: Company founder Dan Evins led the company until 2001, when he was succeeded by Michael Woodhouse. In September 2011, Sandra B. Cochran became the company's CEO and president. Cochran was the second woman in Tennessee to hold that office in a publicly traded company. She held the position until August 2023, when Julie Felss Masino was named as Cochran's successor. In July 2026, the company announced that Ms. Masino would resign in August 2026. The company said that David Deno will succeed her as CEO.
